title: polyglot-stream-resilience-token-rotation-and-ergonomics-bump
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Improve streaming client resilience and safe token rotation across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. Add ergonomic iterator helpers and bump patch versions. No breaking changes.
description:
Context and motivation: We observed two recurring issues in customer integrations that use long-lived streams: 1) mid-stream token refreshes could occasionally close the stream unexpectedly or cause duplicated events, and 2) ergonomics for consuming streamed responses across SDKs were inconsistent (async iterator vs event emitter patterns), which increased integration friction. This PR delivers coordinated fixes and parity improvements across the three SDKs.

What this PR does (single continuous description): Implements a safe token-rotation handshake that pauses the stream consumer loop while the auth token swap completes and resumes without losing in-flight chunks; introduces an opt-in 'resilientStream' wrapper across Python/TS/Go that standardizes backpressure-friendly async iteration, reconnection with idempotent resume tokens, and exponential jittered backoff on transient network errors; cleans up public ergonomics by adding a small helper API (stream.resume(), stream.pause(), stream.as_iterator()) to reduce integration boilerplate; fixes parity bugs noted in ENG-2143 (TS previously omitted final newline-preservation behavior), and ENG-2198 (Python had one-off cursor handling in the reattach path). Bumps SDK patch versions: python 0.14.3 -> 0.14.4, typescript 1.7.0 -> 1.7.1, go 0.8.9 -> 0.8.10. Adds end-to-end streaming tests and CI job permutations to run cross-SDK replay/resume scenarios.

Checklist:
- [x] Safe token swap handshake across SDKs
- [x] Resilient stream wrapper with backoff and resume token support
- [x] Unified ergonomic helpers (pause/resume/iterator)
- [x] Parity fixes for newline preservation and cursor handling
- [x] Added unit + e2e tests (simulated partial failures)
- [x] Updated changelogs and bumped patch versions
- [x] CI green on all SDK permutations

High-level commits summary (see commits field for detail): coordinated changes touching each SDK client, test harness additions (stream-fault-injector), and small doc snippets in SDK READMEs.

Notes/risks: The token-rotation protocol is opt-in behind the resilientStream flag to reduce blast radius. Default behavior remains backward compatible. Resume logic requires server support for resume tokens; for older servers the wrapper falls back to restart-on-failure behavior with a warning.

Related: Linear ENG-2143, ENG-2198. No linked Jira.

Maya Patel (author): Added the e2e duplicate-chunk assertion and configurable env var REDWOOD_STREAM_TOKEN_SWAP_TIMEOUT (default 5s).
Aria Gomez (reviewer): TS impl looks good. Suggest tightening types on the iterator to avoid 'any' and add a small example in README showing pause/resume usage.
Maya Patel (author): Reworked types to StreamChunk<T> and added README snippet. Thanks!

Samir Rao (reviewer): Go change is fine but please ensure the backoff jitter bounds are aligned with the runtime's existing retry constants. Also CI flaked once in go test; can we add a retry in the CI step?
Maya Patel (author): Aligned jitter bounds to runtime constants and added a retry wrapper in the CI job for the go tests.
